name: @strumentario/widget
description: MCP App widget as a vanilla web component (<strumentario-page-widget>) over the Strumentario query, validate and mutate tools; prop types generated from the server's tool contracts

scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @strumentario/server run build && pnpm run build && node dist/generate-cli.js
scripts.generate:check: pnpm --filter @strumentario/server run build && pnpm run build && node dist/generate-cli.js --check
scripts.harness: pnpm --filter @strumentario/server run build && pnpm run build && node dist/harness/serve.js
